name: Icon Frontmatter Mirror
changes: The plugin now saves its record of written values after each 200 notes that it checks and when a run ends or stops. So after a reload during a long first run, it still updates and removes the values that it wrote.

When you remove the last of 1 to 3 icons in Iconize, the plugin now removes the property and shows no notice. A data file with no icons holds the removals only when the last read with icons had more than 3 icons, or, at the first read after a start, when more than 3 notes have values that the plugin wrote.
tip: Set an icon with Iconize as you always do. After 2 to 4 seconds, the note has the same icon in its icon property. Run Mirror icons now from the command palette to update all notes at once.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Icon Frontmatter Mirror is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
